title: From Helpfulness to Toxic Proactivity: Diagnosing Behavioral Misalignment in LLM Agents
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focused on a phenomenon termed 'Toxic Proactivity,' where LLM agents prioritize utility over ethics in domains like coding, healthcare, cybersecurity, and finance.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the research.
